paragraphs: Align Technology, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Align" or the "Company") is a global medical device company primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of Invisalign® clear aligners for the treatment of malocclusions, or the misalignment of teeth, by orthodontists and general dental practitioners ("GPs"), ViveraTM retainers for retention, iTeroTM intraoral scanners and services for dentistry, and exocadTM computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing ("CAD/CAM") software for dental laboratories and dental practitioners. Our vision and strategy is to revolutionize orthodontic and restorative dentistry through digital treatment planning and implementation using the AlignTM Digital Platform, an integrated suite of proprietary technologies and services designed to deliver a seamless, end-to-end solution for patients, consumers, orthodontists, GPs and lab partners. We strive to achieve our vision and strategy through key objectives made possible with the proprietary technologies and services of the AlignTM Digital Platform to establish: clear aligners as the principal solution for the treatment of malocclusions with the Invisalign System as the treatment solution of choice by orthodontists, GPs and patients
globally, our iTero intraoral scanners as the preferred scanning technology for digital dental scans and our exocad CAD/CAM software as the dental restorative solution of choice for dental labs.

Our corporate headquarters are located at 410 North Scottsdale Road, Suite 1300, Tempe, Arizona 85288. Our telephone number is 602-742-2000. Our internet address is www.aligntech.com. Our Americas regional headquarters is located in Raleigh, North Carolina, U.S.A.; our European, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") regional headquarters is located in Rotkreuz, Switzerland; and our Asia Pacific ("APAC") regional headquarters is located in Singapore.

We have two operating segments: (1) Clear Aligner and (2) Imaging Systems and CAD/CAM Services ("Systems and Services"). For the year ended December 31, 2025, Clear Aligner net revenues represented approximately 80% of worldwide net revenues, while Systems and Services net revenues represented the remaining 20%. We sell the majority of our products and services directly through a dedicated and specialized sales force to our customers: orthodontists, GPs, including prosthodontists, periodontists, oral surgeons and dental laboratories. We also sell through sales agents and distributors in certain countries. In addition, we sell directly to dental support organizations ("DSOs") who contract with dental practices to provide critical business management and support, including non-clinical operations. We also sell our products to dental laboratories who use our products to manufacture or customize their own products for licensed dentists. We furthermore market and sell doctor and consumer accessory products complementary to our doctor-prescribed principal products under the Invisalign® and other brand names, including retainers, dental supplies, clear aligner cases (clamshells), ultrasonic and UV electronic cleaning devices, teeth whitening products and cleaning solutions (collectively, "Invisalign Accessory Products"). Depending on the product, our Invisalign Accessory Products are sold through a variety of channels, including online through large e-commerce websites, our doctor portal and in-store through large retailers and pharmacy stores.

Our clear aligners are sold under the Invisalign® brand name. Our Invisalign System is intended mainly for the treatment of malocclusions and is designed to help dental professionals achieve the clinical outcomes they expect and the results patients desire. To date, over 22 million people worldwide have been treated with the Invisalign System. In order to provide Invisalign treatment to their patients, orthodontists and GPs must initially complete an Invisalign training course. Our iTero intraoral scanners are used by dental professionals, labs, and service providers for restorative and orthodontic digital procedures, Invisalign case submissions, and comprehensive digital dentistry diagnosis, treatment planning and treatment monitoring. Our exocad CAD/CAM software products provide restorative dentistry, implantology, guided surgery and smile design to dental labs and dental practices through fully integrated workflows, with the goal to provide cross-disciplinary dentistry in labs and at chairside.

For nearly 30 years, Align has been transforming smiles and changing lives; driving innovation in digital orthodontics and dentistry, helping doctors transform their practices using digital tools and technology to deliver exceptional, modern treatment

experiences and outcomes to over 22 million people worldwide. The AlignTM Digital Platform is the foundation of our goal to lead the digital revolution in orthodontics, restorative dentistry and comprehensive digital dentistry by delivering seamless workflows in dental practices, on mobile devices, and through remote monitoring, as well as diagnostic and treatment solutions designed to improve all aspects of assessment and treatment, from initial consultations to final smiles with our doctor-centered treatment model.

The AlignTM Digital Platform is an end-to-end digital platform that combines software, systems and services designed to provide a seamless experience and end-to-end workflow that integrates and connects those critical to successful treatment outcomes – doctors, labs, patients and consumers. At the center of the AlignTM Digital Platform are Invisalign clear aligners, iTero intraoral scanners and exocad CAD/CAM software.

The AlignTM Digital Platform utilizes the AlignTM Digital Workflow to enable an end-to-end digital treatment experience and generate interconnected workflows and treatment solutions. The AlignTM Digital Workflow includes dedicated tools and capabilities for each stage of the Invisalign treatment journey:

•Connect: The initial stage of the platform drives consumer demand and connects potential patients to our websites and the websites of Invisalign providers. Some of the tools that support this stage are Invisalign.com, Invisalign® Doctor Locator, Invisalign SmileViewTM tool, Invisalign® Practice App, Invisalign® Virtual Appointment and My InvisalignTM app.

•Scan: During this stage, patient data is captured through intraoral scanning. Doctors and their staffs use intraoral scanning tools designed to support diagnosis of a patient's oral conditions and health and support doctors to develop appropriate treatment pathways. Visualization of their potential smiles helps patients understand the benefits of treatment and increases patient conversion. The tools that support this stage include iTero intraoral scanners and exocad CAD/CAM imaging systems, Invisalign® Outcome Simulator Pro, iTero ElementTM 5D auto-upload feature, iTeroTM Near Infra-Red Imaging (NIRI) technology, iTeroTM Scan Report, iTeroTM TimeLapse Technology and iTero-exocad ConnectorTM.

•Diagnose: Doctors can access and use tools that support diagnosis of a patient's oral health and develop an appropriate treatment pathway. The AlignTM Digital Platform facilitates the doctor-patient conversation, through education regarding clinical needs and setting expectations. Some of the tools that support this stage include AlignTM Oral Health Suite, Align X-ray Insights, iTeroTM intraoral scanners, including those with NIRI technology, iTeroTM TimeLapse technology and iTeroTM Occlusogram.

•Plan: Doctors digitally visualize and plan orthodontic and restorative treatments. Orthodontists and GPs can use our products to design, build and share their vision for treatment planning and agree on a customized plan with their patients to reach the desired outcomes. Some of the tools that support this stage are ClinCheck® Pro Software, 3D Controls in ClinCheck® Pro, ClinCheck® Plan Editor, Invisalign® Personalized Plan, CBCT integration for ClinCheck®, and Invisalign Smile Architect™.

•Treat: During this stage, doctors treat their patients with our Invisalign® clear aligners and may offer teeth whitening using the InvisalignTM Professional Whitening System. The Invisalign® Palatal Expander System and the Invisalign® System with mandibular advancement with occlusal blocks and enhanced precision wings, and SmartTrack™ material, SmartForce™ features and SmartStage™ technology are additional products that support patient treatment.

paragraphs: Our business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition, cash flows and stock price can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, or that we currently believe to be material. including those described below. When any one or more of these risks materialize from time to time, our business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition, cash flows and stock price can be materially and adversely affected. The risks below are not the only ones we face. Because of the following factors, as well as other factors affecting our results of operations and financial condition, past financial performance should not be considered to be a reliable indicator of future performance, and investors should not use historical trends to anticipate results or trends in future periods. Therefore, you should review this section carefully, as well as our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto and other information appearing in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, for important information regarding these and other risks that may affect us. Additionally, you should consider these risk factors in connection with evaluating the forward-looking statements contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Macroeconomic conditions impact consumer confidence and discretionary spending, which can reduce or shift spending away from elective procedures, drive patients to pursue less costly orthodontic treatments, decrease the number of orthodontic case starts, reduce patient traffic in dental offices, or reduce demand for dental services generally. Consumer spending habits are affected by, among other things, fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, changes in consumer confidence and demand, inflation, general economic weakness, actual or potential slowdowns or recessions, employment levels, health insurance coverage, wages, debt obligations, discretionary income, interest rates, cultural and social influences, market volatility and perceptions of current and future economic conditions. For instance, decreased demand for dental services has and may in the future cause doctors and labs to revert to wires and brackets and postpone investments in capital equipment. Uncertain economic outlooks for, or declines in the economic outlooks of, the United States, Chinese, European and other economies have and could in the future materially adversely affect consumer demand and dental practice spending. Higher interest rates have and could in the future reduce consumers' disposable income, which could cause a decrease in discretionary spending for our products.

Inflation has and may continue to adversely impact spending and trade activities, and may unpredictably impact global and regional economies. Efforts by central banks and federal, state and local governments to combat inflation could result in an economic recession or slowdown or adversely impact consumer spending for a prolonged period of time. Higher inflation, as well as the cost of fuel, energy and domestic and international shipping costs, food and other essential or discretionary items,

raw material prices and labor rates, has and may continue to rise, which could adversely impact the costs of producing, procuring and shipping our products. We may not be able to fully mitigate the impact of the increased costs or pass price increases on to our customers, which could result in downward pressure on our operating results. Attempts to offset cost increases with price increases may reduce sales, increase customer dissatisfaction or otherwise harm our reputation. Any of these events could materially affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.

We have significant international operations and sales and are therefore exposed to fluctuations in foreign currencies that have and may continue to adversely impact our business, financial condition or results of operations. Although the U.S. dollar is our reporting currency, a large portion of our net revenues and expenses are generated in foreign currencies. While we forecast our balance sheet exposures to foreign currency fluctuations and utilize foreign currency forward contracts to moderate the impact of currency fluctuations on certain assets and liabilities, these contracts may not eliminate our exposure. Currency exchange rate fluctuations have and may continue to materially adversely affect our results of operations and cash flows.

Geopolitical events, wars, military actions, terrorism, or major public health crises have and could in the future harm or disrupt international commerce and the global economy, and could materially adversely affect our business. Such events have and could result in, among other things, supply chain and trade disruptions, changes in diplomatic and trade relationships, new and retaliatory tariffs, trade protection measures, quotas, embargoes, trade sanctions and countersanctions, customs investigations or restrictions, boycotts, reduced consumer spending, government shutdowns, cyberattacks, energy shortages or power outages, energy rationing that adversely impacts our manufacturing facilities, rising fuel or rising costs of producing, procuring, and shipping our products, constraints, volatility or disruption in the financial markets, employee deaths or injuries, restrictions and shortages of food, water, shelter and medical supplies, data or information exchange, disruptions, interruptions or limitations in telecommunication services, critical systems or applications reliant on a stable and uninterrupted communications infrastructure, and protests that may impact delivery of our products to customers or destruction of property. Such events may also cause a shift in public opinion about companies based in the United States or in the regions where we operate or plan to operate, which could adversely impact our reputation and business.

We strive to help our doctor customers move their practices forward by connecting them with new patients, providing digital solutions to help increase practice efficiency and helping them deliver the best possible treatment outcomes and experiences to millions of people around the world. We strive to achieve this through our continued focus on, and execution of, our strategic growth drivers:

Orthodontist Utilization: Continually innovating in digital orthodontics to increase product applicability and predictability to address a range of malocclusion, especially for teens and growing patients, enabling doctors to confidently diagnose and treat more patients.

Our growth strategy depends on our ability to facilitate the digital transformation of dentistry, our continuous focus on innovation, and expansion to meet and exceed evolving customer expectations as the array of products and services available to them increases.
We strive to deliver on each of our strategic growth drivers through a variety of interrelated enterprise-wide efforts including:

•Continuing penetration and adoption of Invisalign® clear aligners, iTero Element™ and Lumina™ intraoral scanners and exocad™ CAD/CAM solutions in international markets by investing in manufacturing operations, research and development, clinical treatment planning, sales and marketing and building our quality and regulatory capabilities in existing and emerging markets globally. Our fabrication facilities in our three key regions and treatment planning operations in targeted regional geographies brings our operations closer to our customers and enables us to serve them more quickly and respond to their needs more effectively. We have also diversified our research and development activities, which has created a longer term, more stable environment for consistent hiring, retention and innovation in a variety of high technology locations.

•Targeting growth opportunities with international orthodontists and GP customers, particularly with adopters of digital dentistry platforms by tailoring our sales and marketing strategies, manufacturing operations and resources around the unique needs of each customer channel. As we continue growing, we intend to opportunistically expand our research, development, manufacturing, treatment planning, and sales and marketing operations to meet local and regional demand thoughtfully and deliberately. Over the longer-term, we expect international revenues to grow faster than Americas' revenues as a result of growing international demand, our continued investment in international market expansion, the size of the market opportunities and our relatively low market penetration in these regions.

•Building confidence within the GP and orthodontic communities through training and education efforts to increase their adoption and utilization of digital dental practice transformation and clear aligner treatment. We continue to expand our clear aligner customer base by educating new doctors on the benefits of digital dentistry through the Invisalign System. We furthermore demonstrate to GPs and orthodontists how the iTero portfolio of intraoral scanners, products like Invisalign Go™ treatment, and exocad™ CAD/CAM restorative services and workflows can increase revenues and profitability for their dental practices by enhancing patient experiences and creating operational practice efficiencies. DSOs represent a large and growing opportunity to help drive adoption of digital technology across the dental industry. We have well established relationships with many DSOs globally that recognize the benefits of digital workflows enabled by our portfolio of products and services that make up the AlignTM Digital Platform, including increased practice efficiency and profitability, as well as delivering a better patient experience from shorter cycle times to customer proximity. We have and may continue to financially invest in or explore collaborations with key ecosystem partners, including DSOs, whose missions and visions align with our vision, strategy, business model and goals.

•Investing in research and development that allows us to innovate, develop and bring to market products and solutions that deliver the ever-increasing clinical precision and predictability that doctors expect with the speed and convenience their patients require. For instance, in 2025, we announced several new enhancements to the AlignTM Digital Platform, including (i) restorative capabilities to our iTero Lumina™ intraoral scanner (without iTero NIRI technology) and the new iTero Lumina™ Pro dental imaging system (with iTero NIRI technology), and (ii) iTero Digital Solutions, a comprehensive ecosystem that includes intraoral scanners and integrated software tools, including enhancements to the Align™ Oral Health Suite, Invisalign® Outcome Simulator Pro with ClinCheck® Smile Video, and the iTero™ Design Suite. Additionally, we continue to invest in AI infrastructure, specialized talent, and strategic partnerships to further enhance the capabilities of the Align™ Digital Platform and differentiate our product portfolio from traditional and emerging competitors. We believe our commitment to AI can unlock new and adjacent market opportunities, and sharpen our operational focus and capital efficiency by driving automation, scalability, and productivity across our operations, while enabling doctors and their patients to benefit from more efficient and predictable treatment experiences. We maintain governance frameworks, internal controls, and oversight mechanisms designed to promote responsible AI development and deployment, mitigate associated risks, and ensure alignment with applicable laws.

•Creating demand and enabling patient conversion with targeted investments in advertising and public relations through television, film, print, social media and alliances with professional sports teams, athletes, social media influencers and other strategic partners, to encourage treatment by Invisalign trained doctors. We believe that well-designed, targeted sales and marketing promotions that build on our strong brand awareness allow us to differentiate our products and solutions from traditional and emerging competitors. To increase awareness and educate young adults, parents and teens about the benefits of Invisalign treatment, in 2025, we continued to invest in and create campaigns across markets in media platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, SnapChat, WeChat, and Douyin. We expect to make further investments to stimulate additional demand for Invisalign System treatment and drive more consumers to dental professionals for those treatments.

•Pursuing new product lines that complement our doctor-prescribed principal products currently available in certain e-commerce and retail channels in the United States. Similarly, in 2025, we continued our focus on our doctor subscription plan and grew our underpenetrated share of the retainer business through strategic marketing campaigns focused on driving adoption and increasing market share.

•Increasing global orthodontic utilization rates as doctors' clinical confidence in the efficacy and predictability of the Invisalign System increases with advancements in products and technology and as patients and doctors demand treatments that emphasize convenience and safety through fewer visits and less invasive and quicker treatments. In addition, the teenage and younger market makes up approximately 70% of the estimated 22 million total annual global orthodontic case starts. We offer early interceptive treatment to this patient population with products designed to acclimate them to wearing removable devices. Included in these treatments are the Invisalign First Phase 1 Package, designed specifically for younger patients generally between the ages of six and ten. Also included are Invisalign Palatal Expanders, a series of removable devices that treat the most common skeletal and dental malocclusions in growing children, and the Invisalign System with mandibular advancement featuring occlusal blocks, which addresses Class II skeletal and dental correction for growing patients in the late mixed or early permanent dentition stages (ages 10-16). We furthermore continue to emphasize the benefits of the Invisalign System for teenage and younger patient treatments through education, training and sales and marketing programs. In 2025, a record number of teens and kids started treatment with Invisalign clear aligners. We expect utilization rates to continue to rise. However, our utilization rates will fluctuate from period to period due to a variety of factors, which may include seasonal trends in our business, consumer demand due to macroeconomic factors, and adoption rates for new products and features.

paragraphs: Align Technology, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Align" or the "Company") 為一間全球醫療器材公司，主要從事 Invisalign® 無痕牙套的設計、製造與行銷，用以治療齒列不正（malocclusions），或齒齒排列不正確，由正牙醫師（orthodontists）與一般牙醫師（"GPs"）使用。此外，我們也提供 ViveraTM 維持器用以維持治療效果、iTeroTM 口內掃描器與相關服務，以及 exocadTM 計算機輔助設計與製造（"CAD/CAM"）軟體，供牙科實驗室與牙醫師使用。我們的願景與策略為透過數位治療計畫與執行，利用 AlignTM 數位平台，這是一套整合的專有技術與服務，提供患者、消費者、正牙醫師、GPs 與實驗室夥伴一個順暢的端到端解決方案。我們透過關鍵目標來實現願景與策略，這些目標透過 AlignTM 數位平台的專有技術與服務達成，以建立：Invisalign 系統作為治療齒列不正的首選解決方案，由正牙醫師、GPs 與患者使用
在全球範圍內，我們的 iTero 口內掃描器為數位牙科掃描的首選技術，而我們的 exocad CAD/CAM 軟體為牙科修復的首選解決方案，由牙科實驗室使用。
本公司總部位於 410 North Scottsdale Road, Suite 1300, Tempe, Arizona 85288。電話號碼為 602-742-2000。網際網路地址為 www.aligntech.com。我們在美洲地區的總部位於美國北卡羅來納州 Raleigh；歐洲、中東及非洲（"EMEA"）地區的總部位於瑞士 Rotkreuz；亞太（"APAC"）地區的總部位於新加坡。

我們有兩個營運分部：(1) 無痕牙套與 (2) 影像系統與 CAD/CAM 服務（"系統與服務"）。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，無痕牙套的淨銷售額約佔全球淨銷售額的 80%，而系統與服務的淨銷售額則佔餘下的 20%。我們主要透過專門的銷售團隊直接向客戶銷售產品與服務，客戶包括正牙醫師、GPs，包括假牙醫師、牙周病學家、口腔外科醫生與牙科實驗室。我們也在某些國家透過銷售代理商與經銷商進行銷售。此外，我們也直接向牙科支援組織（"DSOs"）銷售產品，這些組織與牙科診所簽約，提供關鍵的業務管理與支援，包括非臨牀運作。我們也向牙科實驗室銷售產品，這些實驗室使用我們的產品製造或客製化他們自己的產品，供經許可的牙醫師使用。我們還透過 Invisalign® 及其他品牌名稱銷售與行銷與我們的醫生處方產品相輔相成的醫生與消費者配件產品，包括維持器、牙科用品、無痕牙套盒（clamshells）、超聲波與紫外線電子清潔設備、牙齒美白產品與清潔溶液（ collectively, "Invisalign 配件產品"）。根據產品類型，我們的 Invisalign 配件產品透過多種通路銷售，包括透過大型電商網站、我們的醫生入口網站以及實體店面透過大型零售商與藥局銷售。

我們的無痕牙套以 Invisalign® 品牌名稱銷售。Invisalign 系統主要用於治療齒列不正，並設計用以協助牙科專業人員達成他們預期的臨牀結果與患者期望的結果。截至目前為止，全球已有超過 2200 萬人接受 Invisalign 系統治療。為提供 Invisalign 治療給他們的患者，正牙醫師與 GPs 必須先完成 Invisalign 培訓課程。我們的 iTero 口內掃描器被牙科專業人員、實驗室與服務供應商用於修復與正牙數位程序、Invisalign 案例提交，以及全面的數位牙科診斷、治療計畫與治療監測。我們的 exocad CAD/CAM 軟體產品透過完全整合的流程，為牙科實驗室與牙科診所提供修復牙科、植牙學、引導手術與微笑設計，目標為在實驗室與診所內提供跨學科的牙科服務。
近 30 年來，Align 一直在改變笑容與改變人生；推動數位正牙學與牙科的創新，協助醫生透過數位工具與技術轉變他們的診所，提供超過 2200 萬人全球範圍內的卓越現代治療經驗與結果。
AlignTM 數位平台是我們領導正牙學、修復牙科與全面數位牙科數位革命的基礎，透過在牙科診所內、移動裝置上與遠端監測中提供順暢的流程，以及設計用以改善評估與治療各方面的診斷與治療解決方案，從初始諮詢到最終的笑容，透過以醫生為中心的治療模式。
AlignTM 數位平台是一套端到端的數位平台，結合軟體、系統與服務，設計用以提供順暢的體驗與端到端流程，整合並連接對成功治療結果至關重要的各方 – 醫生、實驗室、患者與消費者。AlignTM 數位平台的核心為 Invisalign 無痕牙套、iTero 口內掃描器與 exocad CAD/CAM 軟體。
AlignTM 數位平台利用 AlignTM 數位作業流程，以提供完整的數位治療體驗，並產生相互連結的作業流程與治療方案。AlignTM 數位作業流程包含專門用於 Invisalign 治療過程各階段的工具與功能：
•Connect：平台的初始階段驅動消費者需求，並將潛在病患與本公司網站及 Invisalign 提供商網站連結。支援此階段的一些工具包括 Invisalign.com、Invisalign® 醫師定位器、Invisalign SmileViewTM 工具、Invis- align® 醫療機構應用程式、Invisalign® 虛擬會診與 My InvisalignTM 應用程式。

•Scan：在這個階段，透過齒內掃描來收集病患資料。醫生及其工作人員會使用專門設計用以支援診斷病患口腔狀況與健康，並協助醫生發展適當治療路徑的齒內掃描工具。他們潛在的笑容視覺化有助病患瞭解治療的優點，並提高病患轉化率。支援此階段的工具包括 iTero 齒內掃描器與 exocad CAD/CAM 影像系統、Invisalign® 結果模擬器 Pro、iTero ElementTM 5D 自動上傳功能、iTeroTM 近紅外線影像（NIRI）技術、iTeroTM 掃描報告、iTeroTM 時序技術與 iTero-exocad ConnectorTM。
•Diagnose：醫生可以使用支援診斷病患口腔健康的工具，並發展適當的治療路徑。AlignTM 數位平台透過臨牀需求的教育與設定期望，促進醫生與病患的對話。支援此階段的一些工具包括 AlignTM 口腔健康套件、Align X-ray Insights、iTeroTM 齒內掃描器（包括具 NIRI 技術的掃描器）、iTeroTM 時序技術與 iTeroTM 咬合圖。

•Plan：醫生可以數位化視覺化並規劃正顎治療與修復治療。正顎專科醫生與一般牙醫師可以使用我們的產品來設計、建造並分享他們的治療規劃視野，並與病患協議個性化計畫以達成預期的結果。支援此階段的一些工具包括 ClinCheck® Pro 軟體、ClinCheck® Pro 中的 3D 控制、ClinCheck® 計畫編輯器、Invisalign® 個性化計畫、ClinCheck® 的 CBCT 整合，以及 Invisalign Smile Architect™。
•Treat：在這個階段，醫生會使用我們的 Invisalign® 清透齒列矯正器來治療病患，並可能提供使用 InvisalignTM 專業美白系統的美白服務。Invisalign® 上頜擴張系統、Invisalign® 具下頜前推與咬合塊及增強精度翼片的系統，以及 SmartTrack™ 材料、SmartForce™ 功能與 SmartStage™ 技術，是支援病患治療的其他產品。

headings: 國際擴張：持續提升全球營運與商業組織的佈局，擴展產品與服務項目，並在更多市場培訓與教育更多牙醫。
一般牙醫（"GP"）治療：透過讓一般牙醫有效執行掃描、辨識、治療與追蹤咬合不正問題，使齒列矯正更符合一般牙醫的臨牀需求。
患者需求：透過建立品牌認知與偏好，使 Invisalign® 系統成為正畸領域最受認可的品牌名稱，並激勵潛在患者開始接受治療。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度報告表 10-K 所包含之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。

有關我們 2025 財年財務狀況及營運成果與 2,024 財年比較之討論，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 中之「營運成果」部分。有關我們 2024 財年財務狀況及營運成果與 2023 年比較之討論，已從本年度報告表 10-K 中省略，但可於我們 2024 財年年度報告表 10-K 中之「第 7 項 管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」找到，該報告已於 2025 年 2 月 28 日向 SEC 提交，並可在 SEC 網站 www.sec.gov 及我們投資者關係網站 investor.aligntech.com 無償取得。
我們致力於協助醫生客戶推動其診所業務，透過與新患者連結、提供數位解決方案以提高診所效率，並協助他們為全球數百萬人提供最佳治療成果與體驗。我們透過持續關注並執行我們的戰略成長驅動力來達成此目標：
正畸醫師使用率：持續創新於數位正畸領域，以提高產品適用性與預測性，以應對各種咬合不正問題，特別是針對青少年及正在生長的患者，使醫生能有信心診斷並治療更多患者。
我們的成長策略依賴我們推動牙科數位轉型的能力、持續創新，以及擴張以符合並超越客戶不斷變化的期待，隨著可供選擇的產品與服務種類增加，客戶的選擇也日益增多。
我們透過多種相互關聯的企業整體努力，來實現每一個戰略成長驅動力，包括：

•持續在國際市場推廣與採用 Invisalign® 無縫牙套、iTero Element™ 與 Lumina™ 口內掃描器及 exocad™ CAD/CAM 解決方案，透過投資製造業務、研究與開發、臨牀治療規劃、銷售與行銷，並在現有及新興市場 globally 建立我們的品質與法規能力。我們在三個主要地區的製造設施與針對特定區域地理的治療規劃業務，使我們的業務更接近客戶，並能更快速地服務客戶，並更有效地回應他們的需求。我們也已多元化研究與開發活動，這已創造出長期更穩定的環境，以確保在各種高科技地點持續聘僱、留住人才與創新。

•針對國際正畸醫師與一般牙科醫師客戶的成長機會，特別是採用數位牙科平台的採用者，透過調整我們的銷售與行銷策略、製造業務與資源，以符合每個客戶渠道的獨特需求。隨著我們持續成長，我們有意機會性地擴展我們的研究、開發、製造、治療規劃與銷售與行銷業務，以符合當地與區域需求，並謹慎而有意識地進行。從長遠來看，我們預期國際收入將比美洲收入成長更快，這是因為國際需求不斷增加、我們持續投資國際市場擴張、市場機會規模以及我們在這些地區相對較低的市場滲透率所致。

•建立在GP及正顎科社羣內的信心，透過培訓與教育措施，以提高他們對數位牙科實踐轉型與透明牙套治療的採用與使用。我們持續擴大透明牙套客戶羣，透過Invisalign System教育新醫生數位牙科的優勢。我們同時向GP及正顎科醫師展示iTero系列口內掃描器、產品如Invisalign Go™治療方案，以及exocad™ CAD/CAM修復服務與工作流程，如何提升他們牙科診所的收入與利潤，透過改善患者體驗與創造運營效率。DSOs代表一個龐大且成長中的機會，以推動數位科技在牙科產業的採用。我們與許多全球DSOs有良好的關係，這些DSOs認知到我們產品與服務組成的AlignTM數位平台所啟動的數位流程的優勢，包括提高診所效率與利潤，以及透過較短的週期時間與更接近客戶，提供更好的患者體驗。我們已投資或可能持續投資或探索與關鍵生態系統夥伴，包括DSOs的合作，這些夥伴的使命與願景與我們的願景、策略、商業模式與目標一致。

•投資於研究與開發，使我們能創新、開發並推出市場上能提供醫生所期待的日益提高的臨牀精準度與預測性的產品與解決方案，同時符合患者所需的速度與便利性。例如，在2025年，我們宣佈了對AlignTM數位平台的數個新功能，包括(i) iTero Lumina™口內掃描器（不包含iTero NIRI技術）與新的iTero Lumina™ Pro牙科影像系統（包含iTero NIRI技術）的修復功能，以及(ii) iTero數位解決方案，一個完整的生態系統，包含口內掃描器與整合軟體工具，包括對Align™口腔健康套件、Invisalign® Outcome Simulator Pro搭配ClinCheck®微笑影片，以及iTero™設計套件的增強。此外，我們持續投資於AI基礎設施、專業人才與戰略合作夥伴，以進一步提升Align™數位平台的能力，並與傳統與新興競爭者區隔產品組合。我們相信我們對AI的承諾能啟動新的與相關市場機會，並透過推動自動化、可擴展性與生產力，提高我們的運營焦點與資本效率，同時讓醫生與其患者受益於更有效率與預測性的治療體驗。我們維護治理架構、內部控制與監督機制，以促進負責任的AI發展與部署，緩解相關風險，並確保與適用法律一致。

•透過電視、電影、印刷、社交媒體與與專業運動隊伍、運動員、社交媒體影響者及其他戰略夥伴的合作，進行針對性的廣告與公共關係投資，以鼓勵由Invisalign培訓過的醫生進行治療。我們相信，設計良好的針對性銷售與行銷活動，建立在強大的品牌認知度之上，使我們能與傳統與新興競爭者區隔產品與解決方案。為提高年輕成人、家長與青少年對Invisalign治療優勢的認知與教育，在2025年，我們持續投資並在TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、SnapChat、WeChat與Douyin等媒體平台進行宣傳活動。我們預期將進一步投資以刺激對Invisalign System治療的更多需求，並促使更多消費者尋求牙科專業人士進行這些治療。
•追求與我們醫生處方的主產品相輔相成的新產品線，這些產品目前可在美國的某些電商與零售渠道中銷售。同樣地，在2025年，我們持續專注於醫生訂閱計劃，並透過戰略性行銷活動，提高我們在未充分開發的保留業務中的市場佔有率。

•提高全球正顎科的使用率，隨著醫生對Invisalign System的臨牀信心因產品與技術的進步而提高，以及患者與醫生對強調便利性與安全性、減少就診次數與較少侵入性與更快治療的治療需求增加。此外，青少年與年輕市場約佔預估2200萬年全球正顎科病例起始數的70%。我們為這一羣體提供早期幹預治療，使用設計用來適應佩戴可移除裝置的產品。這些治療包括Invisalign First Phase 1套件，專為一般年齡在六至十歲之間的年輕患者設計。另外也包括Invisalign Palatal Expanders，一系列可移除裝置，用以治療成長中兒童最常見的顎骨與牙齒咬合問題，以及具下頜前進功能並包含咬合塊的Invisalign System，用以處理成長中患者在晚期混合或早期恆齒階段（年齡10-16歲）的II類顎骨與牙齒矯正問題。我們同時持續強調Invisalign System對青少年與年輕患者治療的優勢，透過教育、培訓與銷售與行銷活動。在2025年，創下紀錄的青少年與兒童開始使用Invisalign透明牙套進行治療。我們預期使用率會持續上升。然而，我們的使用率會因多種因素而從一個期間到另一個期間有所波動，這些因素可能包括我們業務的季節性趨勢、因總體經濟因素而產生的消費者需求，以及新產品與功能的採用率。
下列為可能影響我們運作的重大趨勢與不確定性討論：

headings: 全球及區域經濟情況已並可能在未來對本公司的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響。
本公司受外幣匯率波動影響，此等影響可能對本公司的財務狀況或營運成果產生重大不利影響。
地緣政治事件、關稅與貿易政策，以及軍事衝突已並可能在未來對本公司的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響。
客戶對本公司產品與服務的需求可能不會增加，甚至可能減少，原因包括對本公司部分產品與服務創新性及商業模式顛覆性質的抵觸。
本公司產品與服務所處市場的競爭正在增加。
本公司之成功取決於本公司能否迅速且獲利地開發、製造、行銷，並取得及維持新產品、改進產品或翻新產品與服務之相關法規核准或許可。
本公司每季及每年的營運結果將持續出現波動，未來可能無法準確預測客戶需求的時機與金額，以及本公司收入、成本與支出。
資訊科技系統與軟體整合、實施、更新與升級，或第三方軟體的問題，過去曾導致營運中斷，未來亦可能再次發生，影響本公司營運。
若主要貨運電信業者營運中斷、運費提高或運輸延誤，可能影響本公司供應鏈，進而影響營運與財務結果。
若本公司無法吸引、激勵、培訓或留住人才，將難以達成戰略優先事項，可能對本公司營業、財務狀況與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、聲譽、營運成果、財務狀況、現金流及股票價格可能受多種因素影響，包括目前已知或未知的因素，或本公司目前認為具重大影響的因素，包括以下所描述者。當任何一種或數種風險隨時間發生時，本公司之業務、聲譽、營運成果、財務狀況、現金流及股票價格可能受到重大且不利的影響。以下所列風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。由於以下因素，以及其他影響本公司營運成果與財務狀況的因素，過去之財務表現不應視為未來表現之可靠指標，投資人亦不應以歷史趨勢預測未來期間之結果或趨勢。因此，您應仔細審閱本節，以及本公司合併財務報表及其附註，以及其他出現於本年度報告表10-K之資訊，以取得有關這些及其他可能影響本公司之風險之重要資訊。此外，您應在評估本年度報告表10-K所含之預測性陳述時，考慮這些風險因素。

總體經濟狀況會影響消費者信心與可支配開支，這可能會減少或轉移開支至選擇性手術，促使患者尋求較低成本之正畸治療，減少正畸案例之開案數量，減少牙科診所之患者流量，或總體減少牙科服務之需求。消費者開支習慣受多種因素影響，包括外幣交換率之波動、消費者信心與需求之變化、通貨膨脹、總體經濟之疲軟、實際或潛在之經濟放緩或衰退、就業水平、健康保險覆蓋範圍、工資、債務負擔、可支配收入、利率、文化與社會影響、市場波動以及對目前與未來經濟狀況之看法。例如，對牙科服務之需求減少已導致並可能在未來導致牙科醫生與實驗室回歸使用鋼絲與 brackets 並延後對資本設備之投資。美國、中國、歐洲及其他經濟體之經濟展望不確定或下降，已導致並可能在未來導致消費者需求與牙科診所開支受到重大且不利的影響。較高的利率已導致並可能在未來導致消費者之可支配收入減少，這可能會導致對本公司產品之可支配開支減少。
通貨膨脹已導致並可能持續對開支與貿易活動產生不利影響，並可能對全球與區域經濟產生不可預測的影響。中央銀行與聯邦、州與地方政府為對抗通貨膨脹所採取的措施，可能導致經濟衰退或放緩，或對消費者開支產生長時間的不利影響。較高的通貨膨脹，以及燃料、能源與國內外運輸成本、食品及其他必要或選擇性商品的價格，
原物料價格與勞動成本已導致並可能持續上升，這可能會對本公司產品之生產、採購與運輸成本產生不利影響。本公司可能無法完全抵消成本增加的影響，或將價格上漲轉嫁給客戶，這可能會對本公司營運成果造成向下壓力。為抵消成本增加而提高價格的嘗試，可能會減少銷售、增加客戶不滿意或以其他方式損害本公司聲譽。任何這些事件都可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大影響。
